jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator (Retail Construction, Entry-Level)**

**Location:** Buena Park, CA (On-Site)

**Compensation:** $22.00 - 26.00 per hour (DOE)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Non-exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (1-hour unpaid lunch)

**About StyleKorean**

StyleKorean Inc., operated by SILICON2 Co., Ltd., is a leading global distributor of Korean beauty products, offering a wide range of skincare, makeup, and beauty brands to international markets.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Coordinator (Retail Construction, Entry-Level) to support retail store construction and maintenance projects.

In this role, you will work closely with General Contractors, Architects, Landlords, and internal teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently and on schedule. This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, communicative, and interested in retail construction project coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Project Coordination: Track and update project schedules, timelines, and overall progress of retail construction projects
* Cross-Functional Communication: Communicate and follow up with General Contractors, Architects, Landlords, and internal HQ teams
* Construction Support: Assist with retail store build-outs and fixture (FF&E) installation coordination
* Maintenance Tracking: Monitor maintenance requests and follow up through completion
* Documentation: Organize and maintain project-related documents, contracts, and files
* TI Allowance Support: Assist with preparation of Tenant Improvement (TI) allowance reimbursement documentation
* Issue Management: Identify project issues and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely resolution
* Performing other duties as required

**Qualifications**  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple project timelines
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)
* Ability to follow through and manage tasks independently

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience in retail construction or Tenant Improvement (TI) projects
* Basic understanding of construction drawings, plans, or documentation
* Experience coordinating with contractors or vendors

* Proficiency in AutoCAD or SketchUp is a plus

* Bilingual in Korean and English is preferred, as this role involves communication with our Korean-speaking headquarters and vendors.

**Benefits & Perks**

* 100% company-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (PPO)
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
* Paid Time Off (PTO) + Paid Holidays
* Year-end discretionary bonus program
* Daily catered lunch provided
* Employee discounts on products

***Equal Employment Opportunity***

*StyleKorean Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.*

***Legal Authorization & Background Check***

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Employment sponsorship is not available for this position. Any employment offer is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.*

***Accessibility***

*StyleKorean Inc. will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process, as required under applicable law.*

We sincerely appreciate all applications; however, only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:**

**SEWP - Program Coordinator**

**Position Overview**

Golden Star Technology (GST) is seeking a detail-oriented SEWP Program Coordinator to support the daily operations of our **NASA SEWP contract vehicle**. This role is responsible for reviewing customer RFQs and bids, obtaining vendor pricing, and developing accurate sales quotes, sales proposals, and contract submissions for federal government customers.

The ideal candidate has experience in federal contracting, government procurement, proposal development, and **inside or outside sales**. Success in this role requires the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, and deliver timely, compliant, and competitive responses in a fast-paced technology and public sector sales environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day activities supporting GST's NASA SEWP contract vehicle.
* Review customer **RFQs**, **RFPs**, **RFIs** and bid requests to ensure accurate, complete, and timely responses.
* Obtain and evaluate pricing, product availability, and lead times from OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Build, price, and submit accurate quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for federal government customers.
* Support the full quote-to-order process, including opportunity qualification, quote development, proposal submission, and order handoff.
* Ensure compliance with NASA SEWP contract requirements, federal procurement guidelines, and company policies.
* Partner with Federal Account Executives to support sales opportunities, customer requests, and business growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with procurement, engineering, contracts, finance, and sales teams to develop competitive and compliant solutions.
* Track quote activity, sales pipeline metrics, contract utilization, and proposal status.
* Maintain contract records, customer documentation, and reporting within CRM, ERP, CPQ, and quote management systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years of proven inside or outside sales experience**, including direct customer engagement, **quote generation, proposal development, and sales cycle management.**
* Experience supporting federal government contracts, procurement, or acquisition programs.
* Experience preparing and managing quotes, proposals, bids, and RFQ responses.
* Strong understanding of government purchasing processes and contract compliance requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor partners.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer service communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across sales, procurement, contracts, finance, and vendor teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building, pricing, and submitting complex quotes and proposals for federal government customers.
* Experience supporting NASA Solutions for Enterprise-Wide Procurement **(SEWP)**, General Services Administration **(GSA)** Schedules, Government-Wide Acquisition Contracts **(GWACs),** Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity **(IDIQ)** contracts, or similar federal contract vehicles.

* Knowledge of the **Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)** and government procurement practices.
* Experience working with OEMs, distributors, and vendor pricing programs.
* Experience with **NetSuite, Salesforce,** or other **ERP, CRM, or quote management platforms**.
* Experience in the IT, technology, government contracting, or VAR industry.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**About GST**

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for seven consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions nationwide.

Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. Through strategic partnerships with top manufacturers and visionary technology providers, GST empowers organizations to achieve their business objectives with confidence and efficiency.

For more information, please visit www.gstinc.com

jobs.title: SLAAI Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**SUMMARY**

South LA All In (SLAAI) is a multi-year, coalition-driven initiative designed to address longstanding racial and socioeconomic inequities in South Los Angeles, with a focus on underserved communities east of the 110 Freeway.

SLAAI strengthens South Los Angeles through coordinated investments and partnerships in five priority areas: Good Jobs, Education, Housing Stability & Affordability, Access to Capital, and Social Infrastructure.

Reporting directly to the SLAAI Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and program coordination support across SLAAI initiatives. The position keeps programs organized, documented, and moving by maintaining accurate participant and partner records, coordinating logistics and communications, tracking milestones and performance data, administering surveys, and supporting timely grant and program reporting.

The Program Coordinator works closely with the SLAAI Director, Associate Director, Outreach & Engagement Manager, Outreach Coordinator, CRCD departments, community partners, and the Learning & Evaluation team. This is a coordination and implementation-support position and does not independently set program strategy, approve budgets, supervise staff, make final participant-selection decisions, or assume the direct-service responsibilities of case managers, coaches, or partner agencies.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Position roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
* **Program Coordination:** Maintain initiative workplans, calendars, milestone trackers, task lists, meeting schedules, and follow-up timelines across assigned SLAAI programs.
* **Meeting & Event Logistics:** Coordinate scheduling, invitations, registration, technology, materials, food, room setup, site tours, participant reminders, and other logistics for workshops, trainings, convenings, and community events.
* **Program Materials:** Prepare agendas, meeting packets, sign-in materials, presentations, resource guides, certificates, and other participant and partner documents.
* **Action Item Tracking:** Document decisions, action items, responsible parties, and deadlines; follow up to support timely completion and escalate implementation risks to the Program Manager
* **Data & Records Management:** Maintain complete, accurate, and current participant, partner, referral, attendance, service, training, and outcome records in approved systems, including SharePoint, Forstack, and initiative-specific trackers.
* **Performance Tracking:** Track enrollment, attendance, retention, training completion, referrals, service connections, exit outcomes, and other required performance indicators.
* **Survey Administration:** Coordinate pre-program, session-specific, and post-program surveys in partnership with the Learning & Evaluation team and track response completion.
* **Data Quality:** Review records for completeness, resolve routine discrepancies, and flag missing or inconsistent information before internal and external reporting deadlines.
* **Reporting Support:** Compile documentation, data summaries, success stories, and program files for quarterly and grant reporting led by the Program Manager.
* **File Management & Confidentiality:** Maintain organized, audit-ready electronic files in accordance with CRCD confidentiality, record-retention, and data-security requirements.
* **Participant & Partner Communication:** Provide timely, professional communication to participants, community-based organizations, faith-based institutions, facilitators, guest speakers, and program partners.
* **Enrollment & Onboarding Support:** Support application processing, eligibility-document collection, leadership authorizations, onboarding, and program completion documentation.
* **Engagement Follow-Up:** Track participant engagement and follow-up needs and coordinate with the appropriate outreach, program, or direct service staff when barriers arise.
* **Partner Database Management:** Maintain current contact information, participation history, program roles, referrals, and next steps for partners, facilitators, and guest speakers.
* **Post-Program Coordination:** Support follow-up visits, referrals, technical-assistance coordination, and documentation of participant or partner next steps.

**INITIATIVE-SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Good Jobs Network:** Document and track at least 90 youth and young adult referrals, ages 16–24, during the grant period.
* **Healthcare Career Pathways:** Track clinical and nonclinical participant enrollment, progress, and training completion.
* **Helping Families Thrive:** Maintain complete eligibility, enrollment, service, and outcome records for participating families.
* **CBO Capacity Building:** Maintain workshop attendance records and track completion of pre- and post-assessments.
* **SLAAI Capacity Building Bootcamp:** Document participation and completion of 60 hours of capacity building and technical assistance for 10 enrolled CBOs.
* **CRCD Thought Leadership:** Maintain records of conferences, presentations, audiences, topics, materials, and geographic reach.
* **Project Hope Bridge:** Maintain participant eligibility, referral, housing, service, workforce, subsidy, exit-planning, and outcome records.
* **South LA Is Home:** Maintain application, authorization, attendance, survey, partner, speaker, and next-step records for participating faith-based institutions.

**KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS**

* Maintain complete and current required records for at least 95% of active participants and partners, with corrections completed by established reporting deadlines.
* Document attendance and participation for 100% of assigned workshops, convenings, trainings, and program sessions.
* Enter or update routine program data within five business days of receiving complete source documentation.
* Distribute assigned participant and partner communications by established deadlines

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director, LMU Extension, the incumbent will have experience in public workforce development and disability inclusion programs, particularly in the areas of grant management and program coordination for underserved and underrepresented populations. This position will be responsible for ensuring that all program activities are executed in alignment with the goals of the grant, managing relationships with stakeholders, collecting data, and preparing reports that evaluate the effectiveness of the grant’s initiatives.

**Position Specific Responsibilities/Accountabilities**

**Program Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Coordinate all partner activities related to the grant.
* Serve as the main point of contact for all stakeholders, including state agencies, workforce agencies, community organizations, project awardees, and other external partners.
* Schedule and convene regular meetings with project stakeholders to ensure collaboration, co-enrollment, and co-case management between WIOA Title I and IV programs.
* Promote and sustain a collaborative community centered around integrated service delivery and the goals of the grant.
* Collaborate with The Coelho Center and other internal project partners to ensure program activities are coordinated and align with the goals of the grant.

**Grant & Data Management:**

* Track the progress of the grant, ensuring deliverables are met on time and in accordance with program objectives.
* Work with project partners to collect, analyze, and report on data to evaluate the success of workforce development strategies and programs for people with disabilities (PWD).
* Develop and maintain comprehensive records and data systems related to the grant’s activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
* Assist in the preparation of reports for stakeholders and funders, providing updates on program progress, successes, and challenges.

**Evaluation & Reporting:**

* Coordinate and assist with the developmental evaluation efforts to document lessons learned and generate actionable recommendations for scaling successful strategies.
* Work with stakeholders to analyze program outcomes and identify areas for improvement.
* Compile and prepare detailed reports to assess the impact of pilot awardees project impact on the employment outcomes of people with disabilities.

**Travel & Outreach:**

* Occasionally travel within California to support program stakeholders and attend relevant meetings and conferences related to workforce development and disability inclusion.
* Represent LMU at community events and external meetings to foster partnerships and engage with potential grantees and other stakeholders.

**Loyola Marymount University Expectations**

Exhibit behavior that supports the mission, vision, and values of the university. Communicate and employ interpersonal actions that model high standards of professional, responsible, accountable, and ethical conduct. Demonstrate a commitment to outstanding customer service.

**Requisite Qualifications**

* Typically a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience. Incumbent will be expected to continue upgrading knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to keep abreast of regulation/policy changes.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in program coordination, grant management, or a related field, preferably within public workforce development programs.
* Demonstrated experience with data collection, evaluation methods, and reporting, including experience with workforce development or disability-related programs.
* Familiarity with state and federal workforce development programs, particularly in California. This includes understanding of America's Job Centers and WIOA funded programs.
* Understanding of WIOA Title I and Title IV programs, with experience working with disability inclusion initiatives.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare quantitative and qualitative reports.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with diverse stakeholders.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this position.*

Work is performed in office, community, and field settings. The employee may be required to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, and participate in the program’s on-call rotation.

* Prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing demands.

Idyllically located on the Pacific Coast just south of Los Angeles and adjacent to Orange County, Long Beach is a vibrant city of approximately 450K residents. Known for its diverse and inclusive community, Long Beach features a unique blend of urban sophistication, cultural richness, and coastal charm. The City encompasses about 51 square miles, offering an array of parks, beaches, and recreational opportunities. Residents enjoy mild climate year-round perfect for outdoor activities such as biking, running, water sports, and much more. Long Beach is home to world-class attractions including the Aquarium of the Pacific, the historic Queen Mary, and the annual IndyCar Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach. Long Beach will be the largest venue city for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

Long Beach also boasts a thriving economy supported by industries such as aerospace, education, health services, manufacturing, tourism and professional services. With two advanced educational institutions, California State University Long Beach and Long Beach City College, and robust K-12 schools, the City is a hub for learning and innovation. Transportation options abound. The Long Beach and Metro transit systems along with the City’s own airport provide convenient access throughout the broader Southern California region. Long Beach is recognized as one of the nation’s most walkable and bike-friendly cities.

**CITY GOVERNMENT**

Long Beach operates as a charter city governed by an elected Mayor and nine City Council members elected by district. The City Manager, appointed by the Mayor and City Council, oversees the daily operations of 15 departments and an FY26 annual budget of approximately $3.7B. The City employs over 6,000 full-time and part-time staff; dedicated to providing exceptional public services with the vast majority being represented by eleven employee associations.

* City Departments
* Citywide FY26 Budget
* 2030 Strategic Vision
* Elevate ’28 Infrastructure Investment Plan

The City of Long Beach fosters an environment where every employee is celebrated for their individuality and unique talents they bring to their role. Reflecting the diversity of the community within the workforce is a key priority embraced at every level of the organization—from management to policycreation. City Leadership actively promotes equity and inclusion by partnering with staff and community stakeholders to advance fairness in all initiatives. Transparency remains a cornerstone of these efforts with demographic data, including workforce diversity and pay equity by race and gender, shared publicly to ensure accountability and progress.

**THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT & OPPORTUNITY**

The Department of Economic Development & Opportunity is an innovative department that leverages Federal, State, and City resources to generate growth in property, sales, and transient occupancy taxes that pay for services citywide. The Department continuously works to implement the recommendations of the Grow Long Beach Economic Blueprint. This comprehensive plan provides policy recommendations and will further Long Beach as an innovative ecosystem that lays a foundation for entrepreneurial success from business start-up to growth.

The Department has approximately 90 employees with five bureaus: Business Development, Business Operations, Real Estate Development, Waterfront Development, and Workforce Development. The Department's mission is to create economic opportunities for workers, investors, and entrepreneurs with an annual budget of over $31 million from eight different City funds.

To learn more about the Department visit:

* Department Website
* Department FY 26 Budget
* Grow Long Beach Initiative
* Bureau Website

**THE POSITION**

The Community Program Specialist V (Administrative Services Supervisor) is an unclassified, at-will supervisory position that reports to the Workforce Development Officer and provides leadership and oversight for Data Management, Contracts, and Procurement.

This role is responsible for ensuring integrity, accuracy, and compliance of workforce program data across the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) and other federal, state, and locally funded initiatives. It also oversees contract administration and procurement functions, including the development, monitoring, and compliance of program contracts and purchasing activities. The position plays a key role in strengthening performance accountability, driving continuous improvement, maintaining audit readiness, and advancing equitable service delivery.

This position supervisors a team of three staff—one Data Integrity Specialist, one Training and Contracts Coordinator, and one Contracts and Procurement Specialist, and serves as the lead authority for data governance, reporting systems, performance monitoring, and contracts and procurement functions in support of workforce development programs.

This position offers a hybrid schedule with one (1) telecommute day per work week, and the option of a 9/80 alternative work schedule.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**
----------------------

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**

* Lead and supervise staff responsible for data management, contracts, and procurement, providing strategic direction, guidance, and performance oversight to ensure accurate and timely data reporting and effective contract and procurement administration across all workforce programs.
* Oversee and support the development, implementation, and performance monitoring of contracts and procurement activities, including training contracts and other program-related agreements

Sagar Patel Aesthetics · Beverly Hills, CA · Full-time, in office

Most of our patients find us through our educational content on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and many travel from out of state for surgery. We’re looking for someone who can do a bit of everything: keep the front office running smoothly, help on consult and surgery days, and create the photos and videos that bring patients to us. You’ll be cross-trained across the practice, so you’ll never be stuck in one lane.

**About us**  
Dr. Sagar Patel is a fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeon with a focused practice: chin liposuction, chin implants, buccal fat removal, deep neck lifts, otoplasty and forehead reduction. Most procedures are done with the patient awake under local anesthesia in our Beverly Hills office. We’re a small, close team, and everyone here covers multiple roles.

Full-time. Clinic days run 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Surgery days start at 7:15 a.m.

Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

Our Mission

We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** - more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. jobs.title: Executive Assistant & BD Associate
jobs.description:
Devoted Studios is a globally remote game development company specializing in Co-development, Porting, and End-to-End Art Production for the global gaming industry. We collaborate across time zones to support projects on all major platforms, engines and styles - from AAA titles to emerging technologies.

Our team includes world-class talents who bring deep expertise in external development, pipeline optimization, and creative problem-solving. Whether it's porting games to new systems, enhancing gameplay features, or crafting stunning visuals, Devoted Studios operates as a trusted, flexible extension of our partners' internal teams.

We are proud to be the development partner of choice for industry leaders such as:

* 2K
* Xbox
* Meta
* Obsidian Entertainment
* Turtle Rock Studios
* Gearbox Software

### **About the Role**

Our CEO is deeply involved in sales, partnerships, and running the company day-to-day. We're looking for someone based in Los Angeles who can work alongside her and help turn client conversations and opportunities into real execution across the company.

This is a hands-on, high-trust role. Much of the work involves coordinating internal teams, organizing proposals and deal materials, and ensuring follow-through after client discussions.

We are actively building AI-driven workflows across the company, and the right person will be excited about experimenting with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems while helping implement them across the organization.

### **Responsibilities**

**Sales & Client Partner**

* Act as the CEO’s right hand across the full sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal and ongoing relationship, so she can focus on opening, closing and growing accounts.
* Keep the CEO’s pipeline moving: track every opportunity she’s involved in, own the next steps, and make sure no deal stalls for lack of follow-up.
* Turn the CEO’s client and partner conversations into structured action plans, and rally the right people across BD, production and pre-production to deliver proposals, estimates and materials on time.
* Prepare the CEO for client and partner meetings with sharp, research-backed briefs, and own follow-up afterwards.
* Build decks, documentation and materials for client, partner and contract conversations.
* Stay on top of video game industry news and bring the CEO opportunities, partners and market moves worth acting on.
* Keep the CRM accurate for every account the CEO touches, and report weekly on where each relationship and deal stands.
* Support BD trainings, initiatives and summits that grow the BD team.

**Conferences, Events & Community** (a creative, high-energy part of the role)

* Plan and run the CEO's conference presence end to end, including meeting schedules, materials, travel and logistics, and travel with the CEO when needed.
* Plan and execute company events, industry gatherings, mixers and community initiatives, with related marketing coordination and materials.
* Drive podcast organization and growth with Marketing, including guests, scheduling and production coordination.

**Running the CEO's World**

* Manage and prioritize the CEO's calendar, protect her time, and act as gatekeeper against low-value demands.
* Review and triage the CEO's email, draft replies, take over communications where appropriate, and surface only what needs her.
* Track the CEO's open items and personally chase them across departments, including documents, signatures, approvals and answers, until each one is closed.
* Keep a running tracker of open items and review it with the CEO weekly, so nothing lives in her head.

**In-Person Operations & CEO Co-Pilot**

* Handle everything that needs a person physically there: errands, appointments, home and life coordination, and other personal needs, so they don't pull the CEO's attention from running the company.
* Own the legwork on government and administrative filings, including IRS submissions, working with Finance on content and tracking every item to completion.
* Notice what needs handling and step in proactively, before being asked.
* Be a trusted, steady presence alongside the CEO and create the conditions for her to do her best work.

**Success in the First 30 Days**

* The CEO's calendar runs with no misses.
* Every client meeting has a brief before it and a follow-up within 24 hours.
* An open-items tracker is live and reviewed weekly.
* You own the plan for the next conference end to end.

  
**Requirements**

**Who We're Looking For**

* A driver and finisher who gets people moving, chases things down, and closes loops without being reminded.
* Writes everything down, tracks everything, and reports status before being asked.
* Thrives in a hands-on role that moves between client-facing work and personal support in the same day.
* Has experience as a project manager, producer, or executive assistant to a founder or talent.
* Comfortable working in spreadsheets, Google Workspace, and email-heavy coordination.
* Eager to experiment with AI tools, automation, and cloud systems in practical ways.
* Can coordinate stakeholders, hold people accountable to commitments, and keep work moving.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Available for occasional conference or event support.
* Game industry knowledge is a plus, not a requirement. You'll be trained in your first 30 days.
* Client-facing experience such as account coordination or event sales support is a plus.
* This role includes hands-on personal and administrative support. If that feels beneath you, this isn't your role.

  
**Benefits**

**Why join us? We offer:**

* 401k
* Healthcare
* Paid vacation
* Company closure in Summer and Christmas (1 week for both) as additional paid time off

Salary Range: $30.74/hour - $49.46/hour

  
Pay range: $30.74 - $49.46 an hour

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

jobs.description:
Reliable Industrial Supplies

Customer Service & Purchasing Coordinator

* Reliable Industrial Supplies is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Customer Service & Purchasing Coordinator to work directly with our VA Hospital customers.
* We work almost exclusively with U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) hospitals and healthcare facilities. This position plays an important role in helping VA facilities source and receive the medical, industrial, maintenance, and other products they need.
* The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about supporting VA facilities and the people who serve our nation’s veterans. You will communicate directly with VA customers while managing orders from the initial request or purchase order through sourcing, purchasing, shipping, invoicing, and final delivery.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is organized, resourceful, comfortable working independently, and complex problem solving.

Location

* On site in Huntington Beach, CA for a probationary period of 2-4 months
* Following a probationary training period, the position will be mostly remote with some required on-site office days & facility visits.
* Some infrequent travel required to local VA facilities, 1-2 times per month

Requirements

* Must be able to lift/carry 50lbs
* High School Diploma (or Equivalent GED)
* Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S
* Must have a valid Drivers License and clean driving record
* Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Both verbally and in writing.
* Be dependable, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks and orders simultaneously

Join Reliable Industrial Supplies

This position is ideal for someone who wants more than a traditional customer-service role. You’ll become involved in the entire order process, from receiving a request from a VA facility and researching the product to purchasing, shipping, invoicing, and confirming delivery.

If you are dependable, highly organized, comfortable with detailed administrative work, and excited about supporting VA hospitals and the facilities that care for our nation’s veterans, we encourage you to apply.

The right candidate is:

* Highly motivated and enthusiastic about working directly with VA hospitals and facilities.
* Extremely detail-oriented and comfortable double-checking their work.
* Organized and able to manage multiple customer orders at the same time.
* A strong written and verbal communicator.
* Professional and comfortable speaking with VA customers, vendors & manufacturers
* A resourceful problem-solver who enjoys researching products and finding answers.
* Able to follow established procedures while knowing when to ask for assistance.
* Reliable, responsive, and able to follow tasks through to completion.
* Comfortable working with numbers, pricing, invoices, and spreadsheets.
* Able to work independently while communicating effectively with the team.

Computer & Administrative Skills

Experience or comfort with the following is helpful but we are willing to train the right person if needed.

* QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel Spreadsheets
* Email and electronic file organization
* Online vendor and manufacturer websites
* UPS and FedEx shipping systems
* Product and inventory research
* Data entry and order tracking

Previous experience with VA facilities, government purchasing, medical supplies, industrial supplies, purchasing, distribution, logistics, or customer service is a plus, but is not required.

This Position Is a Good Fit If You…

* Are genuinely interested in working with and supporting VA facilities.
* Like figuring out where to find hard-to-source or unusual products.
* Enjoy helping customers get what they need quickly and accurately.
* Are naturally organized and notice small details.
* Don’t mind switching between phone calls, emails, spreadsheets, purchasing, research, and order processing throughout the day.
* Take ownership of your work and follow tasks through to completion.
* Are comfortable asking questions when something doesn’t look right.
* Enjoy a fast-moving environment where every order can be a little different.

Why This Role Matters

Our VA hospital customers depend on us to locate products, provide accurate pricing, process their orders, coordinate purchasing and shipping, and keep them informed from start to finish. Sometimes the items we are getting for these hospitals are crucial to time sensitive procedures.

The work you do in this position directly supports facilities serving our nation’s veterans. Accuracy, responsiveness, follow-through, and customer service are extremely important to us.

If you’re organized, resourceful, detail-oriented, and enjoy being the person who figures things out, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Customer Service & Order Processing

* Communicate directly with VA Hospital and VA facility customers by phone and email.
* Receive customer purchase orders and accurately enter into QuickBooks.
* Collect and document purchase order numbers, customer contact information, item numbers, quantities, pricing, and delivery requirements.
* Review every order for accuracy before processing.
* Provide customers with order confirmation numbers, estimated delivery dates, tracking information, receipts, and other required documentation by phone and email.
* Respond to customer questions regarding pricing, product availability, existing orders, billing, and shipping.
* Consistently follow up with customers by phone and email.

Product Research & Sourcing : Research is a major part of this position.

* Research medical, industrial, maintenance, and other requested products for VA customers using vendor websites, manufacturer resources, spreadsheets, email records, and online resources.
* Search for products using manufacturer part numbers, descriptions, specifications, and manufacturer information.
* Confirm product availability and lead times with vendors.
* Locate alternative suppliers when a preferred vendor

jobs.title: Third Party Manufacturing Account Manager, Electrical Medical Devices
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

**Job Description**

Provide a focal point for existing and new products manufactured for AbbVie under contract by Third-Party Manufacturers (TPMs), or for products manufactured by AbbVie on a contract basis for Third-Party Customers (TPCs). This role may support pharmaceutical products, combination products and medical devices.

Act as the primary interface between the customer or manufacturer and the appropriate AbbVie support areas. Establish effective communication and working relationships with Third Parties and AbbVie functions, including Legal, MTS, R&D, Materials Management & Logistics, Marketing & BD, QA, Regulatory, MNO, AbbVie manufacturing plants and Program Management. Ensure the proper supply of materials from the TPM or to AbbVie’s Third-Party Customer and manage commitments stipulated in the applicable contracts.

Provide leadership for assigned accounts, including compliance, regulatory updates, capacity planning, cost reductions and control, delivery performance and contract management. With input from the manager, negotiate contract extensions and new contracts.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary contact between AbbVie and Third-Party Customers or Third-Party Manufacturers. Travel to TPM/TPC sites and build productive working relationships, including an understanding of the TPM’s capabilities and/or customer needs.
* Serve as the primary AbbVie interface with executive management at TPMs and TPCs.
* Ensure contract commitments are fulfilled by both parties, and resolve issues when they are not. Engage the appropriate AbbVie resources as needed.
* Assess TPM capacity against long-range plan (LRP) forecasts to determine whether strategic objectives can be met. Proactively communicate concerns to the appropriate organizations.
* Identify opportunities to in-source or out-source products to maximize benefit to AbbVie, as well as opportunities to consolidate work among TPMs.
* Work with appropriate AbbVie functions to negotiate new and extended contracts. Ensure performance metrics are clearly established and included in contract terms, and that contracts align with strategic business objectives.
* Maintain Third-Party Contract information in the applicable contract manufacturing database(s). Track key dates and milestones and ensure they are met or executed.
* Identify TPMs for new and existing products. Support new product launches and transfers, including pharmaceutical products, combination products and medical devices. Provide key forecasting information to TPMs and ensure launch plans can be met.

jobs.title: Client Growth Manager (SaaS / Client Success)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Sunshine Ecommerce LLC is a fast-growing eCommerce SaaS ecosystem helping entrepreneurs launch, manage, and scale online businesses across the United States.

We work closely with our clients to help them grow their businesses through strategic guidance, marketing solutions, operational support, and ongoing business development.

We are expanding our Irvine team and looking for **ambitious, motivated, and results-driven sales professionals** who thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about building client relationships, driving revenue, and exceeding sales goals.

**About The Role**

We are seeking a **Sales Account Manager / Business Growth Manager** to manage and grow an existing portfolio of clients.

* **Sales-Focused Position:** Work toward individual monthly revenue targets and performance goals.
* **Account Management:** Manage existing client relationships while identifying opportunities for business growth.
* **Upselling & Cross-Selling:** Generate additional revenue by offering products, marketing services, advertising solutions, and other business growth opportunities.
* **Client Communication:** Engage with clients through Zoom meetings, phone calls, Intercom messaging, SMS, and email.
* **Revenue Generation:** Close deals, consistently achieve monthly sales targets, and maximize revenue opportunities.
* **Relationship Building:** Develop strong, long-term client relationships that encourage retention and repeat business.
* **Consultative Selling:** Confidently present solutions, discuss investments, handle objections, negotiate, and close sales.
* **Proactive Sales Approach:** Take initiative, identify opportunities, and maintain consistent follow-ups to drive results.

**Ideal Candidate:** A confident, persuasive, self-motivated, and results-driven sales professional who thrives in a performance-based environment.

Your goal is to build strong client relationships, improve engagement, support account growth, and help clients stay active and successful long-term.

**This is a relationship-driven role that combines:**

* customer success,
* SaaS account management,
* retention,
* business consulting,
* and account growth.

This is NOT a cold-calling or high-pressure sales role.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow relationships with existing clients
* Conduct onboarding and strategy Zoom calls
* Help clients navigate and scale their businesses
* Increase long-term client engagement and retention
* Support account expansion and re-investment
* Monitor account health and performance
* Communicate consistently through Zoom, phone, Intercom, text, and email
* Maintain accurate CRM and client communication records
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve client experience

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Strong relationship-building and interpersonal abilities
* Fast learner with strong adaptability
* Positive, professional, and solution-oriented mindset
* Strong consistency and follow-up skills
* Ability to deliver a premium, white-glove customer experience
* Comfortable communicating through Zoom, phone, text, and messaging platforms
* Strong emotional intelligence and people skills
* Highly organized and self-motivated
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:

* eCommerce
* SaaS platforms
* Customer Success
* Client Relations
* Account Management
* Retention
* Sales or Consulting
* Digital Marketing
* Online business operations

Experience with CRM systems, Intercom, Zoom, or similar sales and communication platforms is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* $60,000 annual base salary
* **Additional $30,000–$50,000 in potential annual commissions and performance bonuses**, based on individual sales performance and target achievement
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid Holidays
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Paid training and onboarding
* Career growth opportunities
* Potential hybrid work flexibility after three months, subject to sales performance and management approval

**Work Schedule**

* Full-time
* Monday–Friday
* **Fully in-office during the first three months of employment**. After three months, employees may be eligible for **one remote workday per week**, subject to individual sales performance and management approval.
* Remote work eligibility is performance-dependent and may be modified, suspended, or revoked based on current sales results, productivity, and business needs.
* Employees are expected to maintain consistent performance and meet established sales targets to retain hybrid flexibility.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for **motivated sales professionals who enjoy building relationships but are equally passionate about closing deals and achieving results.**

You should be someone who:

* Enjoys sales and is motivated by commission opportunities.
* Is confident speaking with clients and recommending solutions.
* Takes initiative rather than waiting for opportunities.
* Is comfortable being held accountable to monthly sales targets.
* Thrives in a goal-oriented, competitive, and supportive team environment.
* Is eager to learn, improve, and grow professionally.

**If you're a driven sales professional who enjoys working with existing clients, identifying growth opportunities, and earning commission based on performance, we'd love to hear from you!**

Pay: $60,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

**Position:**

Program Coordinator

**Department:**

Clinical

**Supervisor:**

Clinical Site Director

**FLSA Status:**

Full-Time; Non-Exempt

**Age of Patient Population Served:**

Adults and Adolescent

**Primary Purpose:**

The Program Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative support to the Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) teams while demonstrating a professional and respectful rapport with patients, families, and staff. This Coordinator also provides direct supportive care to selected patients, families, and the clinical team to ensure that services are delivered efficiently and effectively. This position is also the in-person administrative support for on-site outpatient patients and clinicians.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma
* Ability and interest in learning clinical information and criteria. Knowledge of medical terminology
* Computer literacy and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in social work or similar concentration.
* 1–2 years of experience in a healthcare setting is a plus.
* Google Workspace & EMR experience.
* Medical Assistant certification is a plus.

**Core Competencies:**

* Independent Judgment & Problem-Solving
* Organization & Time Management
* Professionalism, Integrity & Reliability
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Adaptability & Team Collaboration
* Emotional Resilience & Patient Awareness

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide administrative support to the Program teams, including the Program Manager/Clinical Operations Director, Clinicians, and patients.
* Demonstrate professional and respectful rapport when interacting with all stakeholders, including patients, family members, co-workers, vendors, and other clinical staff.
* Conducts administrative duties including but not limited to:

  + Coordinate with Admissions to welcome new families to the program.
  + Maintain patient tracking list, updating as needed.
  + Scheduling group and session appointments for IOP/PHP patients.

  + Checking in and checking out patients.
  + Uploading registration paperwork.
  + Responding to email inquiries in a thorough, timely, and courteous manner.
  + Collecting and uploading paperwork.
  + Responding to the needs of patients, clinicians and program managers.
* Work closely with the Clinical Operations Director/Program Manager to coordinate group coverage as needed and provide updates about patient attendance and census.
* Report and track patient attendance and appointment charges daily.
* Facilitate the completion of daily electronic questionnaires with IOP/PHP patients.
* Attend weekly IOP/PHP treatment team meetings to review enrollment of new patients, identify scheduling and discharge planning needs, and facilitate next steps with scheduling.
* Taking vitals (weight, height, blood pressure) and drug test samples as needed.
* Clerical duties include copying, mailing, faxing, scanning, and sorting documentation.
* Performing other miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
* Submitting purchase orders for PHP/IOP Programs and the office as needed.
* Support Clinical Operations Director/Program Manager with Discharge coordination and administrative needs.
* Learn and perform general front desk duties to support outpatient administrative coverage.

  + Answering the phone, providing information, and routing calls appropriately.
  + Greeting outpatients and connecting them with their clinicians.
  + General facility maintenance and upkeep.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Mobility: Ability to move around the treatment facility as needed, including walking, standing, and occasional lifting or moving objects.

**Integrity**: We are honest and accountable for our performance. We treat our patients and colleagues with respect and dignity.

**Quality:** We focus on consistent and competent performance of our duties. Careful attention to communication and follow-through produces excellent delivery of care.

**Compassion:** BACA prides itself on being a safe, comfortable, and contained environment that supports healing, recovery and hope. Every patient is treated with empathy, caring, and kindness.

**Collaboration:** We employ a “whole person” perspective to treatment. To that end, our program not only focuses on the patient, but the family system as well. We pool resources from patients, families, peers, partners and professionals to deliver exceptional care.

At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.

As a Program Specialist, you’ll be the face of the Boosterthon program on elementary school campuses. jobs.title: Associate Program Specialist - Catering Support
jobs.description:
**About the Team**  
  
This role team sits within Uber’s Customer Advocacy & Solutions CX organization which owns the end-to-end support experience for our users. We design and improve support that anticipates customer needs, resolves issues, and builds trust. Our mission is to move beyond resolving tickets to owning customer outcomes. Catering is one of the most operationally complex experiences we support. Orders are large, scheduled, and high-value, often tied to events with fixed start times, such as team offsites, client meetings, or large social gatherings. Each order connects customers, merchants, and couriers, so a single issue can have a significant impact. We build clear support processes and tools that help our global agent network coordinate across these groups and deliver reliable, timely & proactive support.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Program Specialist to grow & improve the end-to-end support experience as Catering grows. You’ll review customer and agent feedback, analyze support performance, and turn insights into better processes, content, and tools. You’ll partner with other Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) and business teams to address root causes and prevent recurring issues. This role combines analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional execution including using AI and automation to simplify recurring workflows.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  
**Understand customer needs and diagnose issues**  

* Review support tickets, customer feedback, and agent insights to identify recurring pain points across the support journey.
* Extract and analyze contact drivers and support trends to diagnose root causes and prioritize recommendations to reduce defects upstream.

  
**Improve support processes, tooling, and automation**  

* Design and improve support workflows, including time-sensitive catering journeys, with clear ownership, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Use AI and automation where appropriate to simplify workflows, accelerate analysis, and reduce manual work while maintaining quality.
* Partner across teams to define tooling requirements, test solutions, and roll out improvements to the customer and agent experience.

  
**Enable frontline teams and prepare for launches**  

* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge-base content clear and current as products and policies change, incorporating frontline feedback.
* Partner with Content, Tooling, Quality, and Training teams to prepare agents for launches and help them resolve more issues at first contact.

  
**Monitor performance and measure impact**  

* Report on key metrics, across experience, efficiency and support promise adherence to highlight trends, risks, and actions to improve performance.
* Work with global support sites and BPO partners to address performance gaps, measure results, and sustain improvements in quality and customer outcomes.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in program/project management, operations, or a highly agile, project-based environment.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree or equivalent.
* 3+ years of experience in customer support, operations, program management, or CX in a fast-paced environment.
* Hands-on experience with contact center platforms, knowledge bases, workflow tools, or support automation.
* Experience designing and improving support processes, SOPs, or playbooks, and helping teams adopt them.
* Basic SQL proficiency and strong analytical skills to retrieve and analyze data, diagnose issues, and measure results.
* Ability to interpret Tableau or other BI dashboards and translate findings into recommendations.

Description

Amethod Public Schools (AMPS) is a mission and values-driven organization. Our mission is to provide a fundamental and rigorous college preparatory education to any student who chooses one of our schools. Our day-to-day work is embodied with a set of core values: **Students First, Be Adaptable,** **Persevere, Take Responsibility, and Commitment to Distinction** or team members who exude these values and a passion for our mission.

**Position Summary**

Under the direction of the Chief Academic Officer or Special Education Designee, the Program Specialist assists and provides administrative support in all matters pertaining to key functions of the Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA), including but not limited to: contract documentation; reconciliation of special education invoices with special education services defined in Individual Education Programs (IEPs); IEP compliance and monitoring; professional development; timely/accurate reporting to the California Department of Education Special Education Division; and managing special education transportation.

**Major duties and responsibilities:**

* Plans programs, provides curricular resources and technical assistance for, and assesses the effectiveness of the program for students with exceptional needs for all Amethod schools
* Ensures the use of best practices in the implementation of pre-referral behavioral interventions, positive behavioral interventions as outlined in the IEP, and implementation of behavioral support and intervention plans by collaborating with school psychologists, other specialists, or site staff, including providing professional development as needed
* Provides leadership in the area of curriculum, instruction, and modification/accommodation for students with diverse learning needs
* Participates in professional development and provides training and support to the Special Ed Team to enhance instruction for students with social communication, behavioral, and learning challenges
* Assumes responsibility for appropriate identification, educational programming, and services for special education students
* Leverages individual and cultural diversity, demonstrating knowledge and understanding of working with ELL students
* Provides support for data-driven decision-making and accountability to improve the instructional program and ensure student progress
* Ensures due process requirements are met to complete the appropriate development of IEPs and provides ongoing monitoring to ensure IDEA compliance
* Participates in evaluation of Ed Specialists and Paraprofessionals and provides support to Principals in the supervision of special education team members.
* Manages complex cases to ensure appropriate special education services, including attending staffing meetings, IEP meetings, and parent conferences
* Applies conflict resolution strategies with parents or other educational partners to resolve disputes related to a student’s IEP, demonstrating knowledge of current IDEA and Amethod policy and procedures
* Assists in the design and facilitation of network-wide professional development for staff, including onboarding of Special Education team members
* Participate in the designing and redesigning of the Amethod special educational program
* Assists in recruiting and screening of special education staff
* Conduct class observation and speak with teachers to support and monitor all behavioral RTI data
* Support in planning and implementing teacher in-service and professional development at each school site
* Perform other related duties as required and assigned

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Broad understanding of the MTSS/RTI structure as it relates to school reform
* Ability to use data for decision-making regarding student needs
* Ability to support professional development in all aspects of intervention methods both academic and behavioral needs
* Ability to work in a high demand environment
* Proven successful teaching or related service experience in Special Education

**Minimum qualifications:**

* Clear CA Education Specialist Credential and CLAD certification required OR CA Related Service Provider Credential/License (School Psychology, Speech and Language Therapy, Occupational Therapy, etc.)
* CPI certification desired
* Bilingual- Spanish desired
* Minimum 3 years of related experience in special education leadership

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $105,000. Salary is commensurate with experience, education, and expertise. A competitive benefits package is also offered. This is a full-time, exempt, 100% in-person position.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Tolmo**
---------------

Tolmo is cybersecurity for the age of AI. Coding agents now ship software faster than any human team can review or secure it; 100+ pull requests per engineer per week is no longer an outlier, and attackers are using the same agents to find and exploit weaknesses in days, not months. The old playbook of quarterly pentests and endless alert queues breaks at this speed.

We're building a new security playbook. Tolmo runs a fleet of AI security agents that reason over a live graph of your entire production system (code, CI, cloud, and telemetry) and continuously attack a faithful copy of it like a real adversary. Every finding arrives validated, with its blast radius and a remediation plan that lands in your workflow, ready for a coding agent to fix. Hours to integrate, days to your first validated finding.

We've done this before: Tolmo's founders built Sqreen (acquired by Datadog) and led security products that thousands of organizations trusted. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator and just getting started.

**The role**
------------

Security is a trust business, and trust gets built in the room. As our Field Marketing Manager, you create the gatherings, executive moments, and account-based campaigns that put Tolmo in front of the CISOs, CTOs, and security engineers at the companies we most want to work with, and you tie every one of them to pipeline.

You'll work hand in hand with the founders and sales, own each program from first idea to follow-up, and write the playbooks we'll grow on. We want a builder, not just a planner: you invent new formats, write your own invites, and set up your own automations.

**When you apply, tell us about a program you built from nothing and what it moved.**

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own our event presence:** the security, AI, and infrastructure conferences that matter (RSAC, Black Hat, BSides, and more), from booth and live demo to the side events people actually remember.
* **Run executive programs:** CISO and CTO dinners, roundtables, and workshops with the right people in the room, in San Francisco and our key markets.
* **Invent new formats:** hacker nights, live red-team demos, and capture-the-flag evenings. Pilot them, keep the ones that land, and turn them into a series.
* **Go after named accounts:** choose target accounts with sales, design multi-channel plays, and turn attention into first meetings.
* **Measure everything:** track sourced and influenced pipeline, cut what doesn't work, and double down on what does.
* **Automate the logistics:** let AI and tooling handle account research, invitations, follow-ups, and reporting, so your time goes to the people.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 5+ years in field marketing, events, or ABM, ideally at a security, developer tools, or infrastructure company.
* A track record of programs that created real pipeline, with numbers you can walk us through.
* At ease with deeply technical audiences and executives alike: you can brief a CISO and hang out with hackers.
* Organized and scrappy, and calm on-site when something breaks.
* Happy to travel regularly for conferences and customer events.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* An existing network in the security community.
* You've run joint events with cloud, security, or AI partners.
* You've built a community of security leaders, formal or informal.
* You've been the first field marketer at an early-stage startup.

**Compensation & benefits**
---------------------------

* **Competitive salary**, depending on level and experience.
* **Early-stage equity:** you're joining early; you'll own a real piece of what we build.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and the equipment you need to do your best work.
* Based in San Francisco; we work in person.

*Tolmo is building a team with wide-ranging backgrounds, perspectives, and paths into security; we think it makes our product and judgment better. If you're excited about this role but don't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants of every background.*

jobs.description:
Account Manager

Global Fire and Safety is hiring an Account Manager to prepare cost estimates and customer quotes for marine fire suppression, detection, and life-saving equipment. You’ll work from customer requests for quotes (RFQs), parts lists, and supplier catalogs to source equipment, evaluate pricing and lead times, calculate margins, and build proposals in Salesforce.

You’ll work with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, Logistics, Accounting, and field technicians to support customer service, inspections, repairs, and renewals. The team shares responsibility for customer service, and you’ll be accountable for the quotes and assignments you handle. Assignments may shift as workloads and business priorities change.

**What you’ll do**

* Prepare itemized estimates, bills of materials, and proposals for marine equipment, spare parts, and equipment packages.
* Request and compare quotes from manufacturers, distributors, and freight partners. Evaluate availability, lead times, freight costs, delivery commitments, and supplier reliability.
* Apply pricing guidelines, volume discounts, and target margins. Recommend pricing exceptions, alternate suppliers, or revised terms for nonstandard requests.
* Advise leadership on whether to pursue, revise, or decline complex bids based on profitability, supplier risk, and the ability to meet customer commitments. Document the rationale for significant recommendations.
* Prepare proposals with itemized pricing, lead times, payment terms, and exclusions for Sales or Account Management review.
* Track quotes, supplier pricing, and bid results in Salesforce and Uptick. Use supplier performance and bid history to recommend improvements to sourcing and quoting practices.
* Hand off won quotes and supporting vendor documentation to Purchasing, Logistics, and Order Fulfillment.
* Communicate promptly with customers and internal teams, keep quote records accurate, and cross-train to support changing workloads.

**What you’ll bring**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Experience in commercial estimating, inside sales quoting, procurement, or industrial equipment supply.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Uptick or comparable quoting or field service software.
* Strong Excel skills, including formulas, lookup functions such as VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, and pricing spreadsheets.
* Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple quote deadlines and communicate clearly with customers, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Two or more years of maritime industry experience.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, logistics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with marine or industrial fire and life safety equipment, such as extinguishers, suppression cylinders and components, alarm components, self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), life jackets, or life rafts.

**Work environment**

This role primarily involves computer and telephone work in an office setting and may involve occasionally lifting or moving items up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
**About Wing:**

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing's fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

**About the Role:**

Wing is looking for a dynamic, highly collaborative **Social Media Manager** to join our Marketing & Communications team, **hybrid-based in Palo Alto, CA**. In this high-impact role, you will own our global social channels, building community and showcasing Wing's safe, lightweight, and neighborly approach to drone delivery across YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X, etc.

This role sits at the heart of building a new brand and its growing community, as well as a category that's on the way to scaling its reach across more than 40 million Americans by 2027. You will bridge high-level corporate strategy with agile, on-the-ground creative execution. You are a creator-at-heart who can bring the best of the craft to meet our business objectives and value our product delivers to people, with an awareness across a complex and nuanced ecosystem of stakeholders. You bring a sharply consumer-focused lens that can break through and connect with the conversations and culture everyday people care about.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own the Global Social & Editorial Calendar: Architect, build, and run Wing's global organic social roadmap across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, etc., establishing an always-on publishing drumbeat that drives brand affinity and category authority.
* Champion Category Ownership & GEO/AEO Indexing: Partner with the owned and paid content teams to create content that can address the category's top questions in an engaging, entertaining, and educational manner.
* Lead High-Visibility Partner Collaborations: Serve as the primary social lead with our internal and external partners. Co-create, pitch, and execute joint social moments that cross-pollinate audiences.
* Be Scrappy & Creator-First: Roll up your sleeves to capture agile, boots-on-the-ground video and photography collaborating closely with in-house creators and external production agencies.
* Drive Community Triage & Advocacy: Cultivate a passionate community of "customers, makers, engineers, and curious minds." Work alongside our Community Specialist to represent the brand in an educational, empathetic, and approachable manner in comments and other engagement channels, elevating real-world customer stories that are a part of the brand and product story.
* Measure Business Impact, Not Just Vanity: Bring rigor to the "why" and the "so what" part of our content strategy and partner with Media, Analytics, and Data Science teams to track meaningful metrics, e.g. Community Engagement Rates, AI Mention rankings, First-Page Category Rankings, and Co-Marketing reach multipliers.

**What You'll Need:**

* 8+ years of marketing experience, including at least 5 years dedicated to social media management, brand content, and community building, ideally at a high-growth consumer brand, food/QSR, retail enterprise, or tech brand.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-channel brand social accounts with proven success such as YouTube channel growth, LinkedIn thought leadership, and short-form video algorithms (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).
* A scrappy, creator-at-heart mindset: hands-on comfort with videography/photography, agile editing apps, and social native storytelling, with an intuitive eye for visual craft and humor.
* Strong strategic acumen: ability to understand complex aviation technology, and B2B partner dynamics and the end customers they care about, translating them into digestible, entertaining consumer narratives.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise brand collaborations and cross-functional partnerships, balancing strict partner brand guidelines with creative independence.
* Familiarity with enterprise social media management and listening platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brand Watch) and modern search/AI discovery trends (SEO, GEO, AI Overviews).
* Excellent communication, copywriting, and presentation skills, with comfort pitching ideas to senior leadership and collaborating with cross-functional leads in Product, Policy, and Comms.
* BA/BS degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Film/Media, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally (as needed).

Wing is an equal opportunity employer and it is Wing's policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity. Employment at Wing is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Wing does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law.

If you have a need that requires accommodation during the interview process due to a disability or special need, please let us know by completing our Candidate Accommodations Request Form.

Job duties, responsibilities, work locations, and schedules may change based on organizational needs.

**About BANANAS Inc.**

BANANAS is a nonprofit organization that supports families, children, and early care and education providers. Our programs help families connect with all types of child care options, from family child care, home-based settings, preschool centers, family, friend, neighbor caregivers, and nannies, so they can work or continue their education. Providers are supported with technical assistance and professional development. We are experts in the field of early care and education, and our wide variety of services supports families and child care providers in raising early learners. * Meet with parents/guardians and/or child care providers to verify initial assessment information.

**About Second Harvest of Silicon** **Valley**

Founded in 1974, Second Harvest of Silicon Valley is one of the largest food banks in the nation and a trusted nonprofit leader in ending local hunger. The organization distributes nutritious food through a network of about 350 nonprofit partners at more than 650 locations across Santa Clara and San Mateo counties. Due to the high cost of living in Silicon Valley, increased prices caused by inflation, and cuts to the federal safety net, Second Harvest is serving 1 in 6 people every month. Second Harvest also connects people to federal nutrition programs and other food resources, and advocates for anti-hunger policies on the local, state and national levels. To learn more about how Second Harvest is responding to the incredible amount of need in Silicon Valley, visit shfb.org.

**About Refold**
----------------

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

**Traction:** 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is an early BDR seat and the pipeline engine for our US market. If you want a role where your outbound directly decides whether the company hits its number, this is it.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Own the top of the funnel:** Research, target, and break into software companies in supply chain, procurement, finance, and professional services automation — the ones where an ERP connector is the thing standing between them and their next enterprise deal
