* **Work the signals:** Learn to hear the buying triggers on a first call — "we rebuild integrations for every customer," "we lost a deal because we didn't have the connector," "our SI missed the deadline again" — and know exactly what to do with each one
* **Run the AI stack:** We already run an AI SDR for enrichment and first-touch outreach. Your edge isn't volume; it's judgement — which accounts matter, which message lands, and when a human needs to take over
* **Qualify with rigour:** Run sharp first conversations, qualify honestly, and hand off to the AE with context they can actually use. A meeting that shouldn't have been booked costs us more than a meeting we missed
* **Go multi-channel:** Email, LinkedIn, phone, and in person. You will pick up the phone
* **Work the room:** Book meetings around PMA, SAP Connect, TSIA, Ai4, and our executive dinner series — before, during, and after
* **Keep the data honest:** HubSpot hygiene, clean notes, accurate stages. Our forecasting is only as good as your inputs

**Role Information**
--------------------

* **Target accounts:** Sales-led software companies with an integrations page, an internal professional services team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Personas you'll open:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, and VPs of Professional Services / Delivery
* **Average deal size you're feeding:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org
* **Path:** This is a clear on-ramp to an AE seat for someone who earns it

**Required Skills & Abilities**
-------------------------------

* **Outbound reps on the board:** 1–3 years in a BDR, SDR, or business development role. At least a year of genuine cold outbound — you've built lists, run sequences, and made the calls
* **Phone-ready:** You're not precious about cold calling, and you don't hide behind email
* **You can write:** A four-sentence email that a CTO actually answers is a real skill, and you have it, or you're obsessed with getting it
* **Technically curious:** You don't need an engineering background, but you should want to understand what an integration is, why it breaks, and why our customers care
* **High output, high coachability:** You take feedback in the morning and apply it that afternoon. You track your own numbers before anyone asks
* **Presence matters:** Based in the SF Bay Area and ready to collaborate in-office 3 days a week

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Prospected into technical buyers or software companies rather than SMB generalists
* Hands-on with HubSpot, Clay, Sales Navigator, or AI-assisted prospecting tooling
* Been the first or second BDR somewhere and had to build the motion, not inherit a playbook
* A technical background, a side project, or anything that shows you can learn a complex product fast

**Compensation:**
-----------------

* $50,000-$70,000

**Why do you want to work here?**
---------------------------------

* **Impact:** Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes
* **Speed:** Early GTM seat with direct founder access and a visible path to closing your own deals
* **Ownership:** You'll help write the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Department of Social Services (DSS) is comprised of the administrative units of the New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) and the Department of Homeless Services (DHS). HRA is dedicated to fighting poverty and income inequality by providing New Yorkers in need with essential benefits such as Food Assistance and Emergency Rental Assistance. DHS is committed to preventing and addressing homelessness in New York City by employing a variety of innovative strategies to help families and individuals successfully exit shelter and return to self-sufficiency as quickly as possible.
  
  
Family Independence Administration (FIA) provides temporary help to individuals and families with social service and economic needs to assist them in reaching self-sufficiency via essential and diverse programs/services, such as: temporary cash assistance, SNAP, childcare, eviction prevention services, adult protective services, job training, employment plans/support, domestic violence assistance, child support enforcement, etc.
  
  
Under general direction, with wide latitude for independent initiative and judgment, the Model Center Project Coordinator assists FIA Deputy Commissioner for Operations and the Regional Office management in planning, implementing, coordinating, monitoring, and evaluating all activities related to the community- based Model Job Centers. He or She prepares evaluation reports by consolidating various Center operations and prepares management reports using Microsoft Excel or similar analytical tools depicting performance by Center and Worker level, as necessary.
  
  
FIA’s Operations is recruiting for one (1) Community Coordinator, to function as a Model Center Project Coordinator, who will:
  
  

* Plan and monitor the implementation, expansion, and overall organization of community-based Model Job Centers by assisting Centers in developing mechanisms to track accountability and progress therein. Assist FIA data reporting staff in the development of new performance indicators and management tools for the purpose of maximizing the Center’s operational performance and ability to achieve Agency goal of moving cash assistance recipients toward economic independence.

  

* Prepare daily evaluation reports on operations of community-based Model Job Centers by collecting data from the Paperless Office System (POS), Welfare Management System (WMS) and Model Center Numbering and Identification Queue (MONIQ) applications and formulating it into reports to identify problematic issues and communicate potential and/or newly discovered negative trends to the Deputy Commissioner for Operations and Center management. Recommends the corrective course of action as needed.

  

* Coordinate with the Division of Job Support Services by participating in intra agency meetings to facilitate the opening and development of community-based Model Job Centers and acts on any decisions made during those meetings in collaboration with the appropriate FIA departments and Community Based Organizations.

  

* Perform analyses and review program plans using various management tools to monitor the community-based Model Center implementation effort, staff performance and program outcomes. Reports findings to the Deputy Commissioner for Operations, Center management, and trainers, as needed.

  

* Collaborate with FIA Office of Policy, Procedures and Training to identify problem areas or issues that warrant further analysis, training, and corrective action. Work closely with the appropriate entities on various projects, including, but not limited to systems implementation, introduction and revision of policies, procedures, and work processes, as related to community-based Model Job Centers and Food Stamp Offices.

  

* Attend HRA’s Office of Community and Constituent Affairs monthly meetings to share FIA's operations information and provide program updates, as appropriate.

jobs.description:
We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm.

**About Us**

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50-plus practices and 21 offices in the world’s major financial centers.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Legal Technology Project Coordinator** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our New York office (hybrid).

**Position Overview**

Manage all aspects of discovery in litigation and regulatory matters using the Firm's legal technology solutions, providing consultative support and applying the Firm's electronic discovery best practices and project management strategies to manage cases efficiently and effectively. This position requires an in-depth understanding of the litigation life cycle, legal technology and electronic discovery.

**Responsibilities**

* Advise attorneys, paralegals and clients on electronic discovery best practices and consult on processes from collection through post-production tasks.
* Liaise with internal case teams, clients, vendors and the Legal Technology staff to support matters throughout all phases of discovery and offer recommendations about design, processes and workflows, including drafting project specifications for vendors.
* Maintain awareness of latest electronic discovery trends and be able to assess any impact they may have on Legal Technology workflows.
* Clearly articulate potential risks and provide possible solutions regarding collection, processing, review and production. Identify issues to escalate to Legal Technology management team.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of the Firm's litigation support software as it pertains to hosting document reviews, preparing productions and performing advanced searches.
* Assist with vendor selection and engagement process in consultation with Legal Technology management and attorneys to ensure the Firm’s vendor engagement procedures are followed including execution of agreements and conducting of security assessments.
* Manage basic aspects of collection, including identification of all sources and locations of electronically stored information.
* Manage all aspects of data processing, including coordinating with processing vendors, tracking custodians reviewing search terms, providing date ranges, determining optimal deduplication methods and troubleshooting processing issues. Communicate detailed processing specifications and instructions to the vendor.
* Manage all aspects of review, including set-up and design of the review database; access permissions, managed review providers and third party vendors; and development of a workflow.
* Manage all aspects of document production preparation, including reviewing production specifications with attorneys for best practices and strategic considerations; insuring productions are consistent and conform to any subpoenas, ESI protocols, joint defense agreements, etc.; running full quality control checks against any proposed production sets in coordination with the Paralegal Discovery Team and working with attorneys to resolve any issues found; and coordinating timing and technical resources with Legal Technology Data Specialists to ensure deadlines are met.
* Conduct quality check on final production volumes and media, including productions prepared by external vendors.
* Manage all aspects of post-production database work, including advising case teams on using databases to create privilege logs, setting up process for deposition/interview preparation, set up process for identifying and reviewing potential trial exhibits including coordination with trial presentation personnel/vendor.
* Support case teams in use of Firm’s generative AI tools in consultation with Legal Technology department management.
* Effectively communicate and provide end-user support and customer service to partners, co-counsel, case teams and clients throughout all phases of litigation and regulatory matters.
* Track progress of projects by maintaining and updating project files and documentation. Update internal case teams and clients as needed.
* Review and verify vendor invoices to ensure costs are consistent with the work performed and with relevant matter budgets.
* Work with Legal Technology management to develop recommendations, proposals, plans, cost estimates, budgets, procedures and specifications for new matters.
* Demonstrate effective interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to facilitate effective work relationships with others.
* Manage Firm resources responsibly.
* Complies with and understands Firm operation, policies and procedures.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of relevant firm computer software programs (e.g., Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to learn new software and operating systems
* Understanding of all aspects of the EDRM and of electronic discovery best practices, trends and techniques
* Understanding of analytics software, technology assisted review and workflows
* Familiarity with various electronic discovery platforms, including Relativity
* Understanding of basic litigation processes, including trial procedures
* Demonstrates effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing
* Demonstrates close attention to detail
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and planning skills
* Strong project management skills

**About America On Tech:**

America On Tech (AOT) is a national nonprofit preparing the next generation of technology leaders from underestimated communities. Since 2014, AOT has provided no-cost tech education and workforce training to students in NYC, LA, Miami, and Atlanta. AOT equips young people with in-demand skills in AI, Web Development, Data Science, and more, creating pathways to higher education and careers. Learn more at www.americaontech.org.

**About the Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program**

The Apple Ecosystem and Swift Training Program is a flagship collaboration between America On Tech (AOT), Apple, the Hispanic Federation (HF), and CUNY. The program equips York College students and local community members with critical digital literacy and coding skills, creating pathways into technology careers.

In 2027, the program will train over 200 individuals across three learning tracks:

* **Apple Ecosystem Digital Literacy & Skills:** Short courses on foundational digital tools (e.g., Email, Numbers, Keynote, Pages, Resume Writing).
* **Intro to Swift Training:** Short courses to learn basic Swift skills and used as a recruitment tool for longer term SWIFT Training Course
* **NC3 Swift Certification Training:** A 96-hour NC3 Swift Certification Training preparing students for industry-recognized credentials.

All classes are held in-person at York College (94-20 Guy R. Brewer Blvd., Jamaica, NY 11451). Each class will include approximately 25 students, a mix of York College students and community members.

### **Position Overview**

America On Tech (AOT) is seeking a Program Coordinator to support the planning, operations, and execution of the Apple Ecosystem and Swift courses from February–December 2027, with onboarding beginning in January 2027. The coordinator will serve as the primary point of contact for students, instructors, and partners to ensure seamless program delivery. This role requires excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, as well as a strong commitment to supporting underestimated students in technology.

The Program Coordinator will work closely with AOT, HF, York College, and Apple staff to manage logistics, support student recruitment and classroom operations.

This role offers the opportunity to be at the forefront of innovative community technology education and to directly impact the career pathways of 200 underestimated students in technology.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Program Logistics (60%)

  + Manage calendars, class schedules, and room reservations at York College.
  + Coordinate with instructors to ensure course materials, devices, and classrooms are prepared.
  + Track student attendance and program participation.
* Student Support (20%)

  + Assist with outreach and enrollment of York College students and community members.
  + Serve as the primary contact for student inquiries.
  + Support students with wraparound services (resume prep, career coaching referrals, access to HF/AOT services).
* Program Monitoring & Reporting (20%)

  + Collect and maintain program data for evaluation and reporting.
  + Liaise with program partners (Apple, HF, and York College) to align on deliverables.
  + Prepare evaluation summaries.
  + Identify and escalate challenges promptly to AOT leadership.

The program coordinator on-boarding will begin in January 2027 and the coordinator will participate in a mandatory in-person Apple training along with the instructor the week of **January 11-15, 2027. Location TBA.**

jobs.title: Associate Program Specialist - Catering Support
jobs.description:
**About the Team**  
  
This role team sits within Uber’s Customer Advocacy & Solutions CX organization which owns the end-to-end support experience for our users. We design and improve support that anticipates customer needs, resolves issues, and builds trust. Our mission is to move beyond resolving tickets to owning customer outcomes. Catering is one of the most operationally complex experiences we support. Orders are large, scheduled, and high-value, often tied to events with fixed start times, such as team offsites, client meetings, or large social gatherings. Each order connects customers, merchants, and couriers, so a single issue can have a significant impact. We build clear support processes and tools that help our global agent network coordinate across these groups and deliver reliable, timely & proactive support.  
  
**About the Role**  
  
We’re looking for an Associate Program Specialist to grow & improve the end-to-end support experience as Catering grows. You’ll review customer and agent feedback, analyze support performance, and turn insights into better processes, content, and tools. You’ll partner with other Customer Advocacy & Solutions (CAS) and business teams to address root causes and prevent recurring issues. This role combines analysis, process improvement, and cross-functional execution including using AI and automation to simplify recurring workflows.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  
  
**Understand customer needs and diagnose issues**  

* Review support tickets, customer feedback, and agent insights to identify recurring pain points across the support journey.
* Extract and analyze contact drivers and support trends to diagnose root causes and prioritize recommendations to reduce defects upstream.

  
**Improve support processes, tooling, and automation**  

* Design and improve support workflows, including time-sensitive catering journeys, with clear ownership, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Use AI and automation where appropriate to simplify workflows, accelerate analysis, and reduce manual work while maintaining quality.
* Partner across teams to define tooling requirements, test solutions, and roll out improvements to the customer and agent experience.

  
**Enable frontline teams and prepare for launches**  

* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge-base content clear and current as products and policies change, incorporating frontline feedback.
* Partner with Content, Tooling, Quality, and Training teams to prepare agents for launches and help them resolve more issues at first contact.

  
**Monitor performance and measure impact**  

* Report on key metrics, across experience, efficiency and support promise adherence to highlight trends, risks, and actions to improve performance.
* Work with global support sites and BPO partners to address performance gaps, measure results, and sustain improvements in quality and customer outcomes.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in program/project management, operations, or a highly agile, project-based environment.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree or equivalent.
* 3+ years of experience in customer support, operations, program management, or CX in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience designing and improving support processes, SOPs, or playbooks, and helping teams adopt them.
* Basic SQL proficiency and strong analytical skills to retrieve and analyze data, diagnose issues, and measure results.

* Experience using customer feedback and data to inform product or process improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into simple, agent-friendly guidance.

jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.

For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20.17/hour (after probation) + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY  
ALICE + OLIVIA is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Production Coordinator to support the planning and execution of recurring e-commerce shoots, as well as editorial, social, and brand productions. This is a hands-on, logistics-driven role requiring strong organizational skills, operational efficiency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is resourceful, solutions-oriented, and takes ownership of responsibilities from start to finish. They anticipate needs, communicate proactively, and ensure production details are executed accurately and efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  

* Coordinate pre-production, on-set logistics, and post-production follow-through for recurring e-commerce shoots while supporting editorial, social, and brand productions.
* Manage production logistics including call sheets, production schedules, casting requests, go-sees, crew coordination, sample preparation, equipment, and shoot requirements.
* Serve as a key liaison between internal departments, freelance crews, agencies, vendors, and external production partners.
* Coordinate freelance bookings, vendor communication, purchase orders, invoices, expense tracking, and budget reconciliation.
* Help ensure freelance styling and photography teams follow established style guides, capture standards, and production workflows.
* Maintain and update e-commerce photography guides, production documentation, calendars, and operational processes.
* Support editorial and social productions through casting coordination, location research, talent outreach, vendor sourcing, and budget tracking.
* Attend and support in-house productions, including set preparation, equipment coordination, day-to-day logistics, and breakdown.
* Maintain an organized and stocked production kit, equipment inventory, and production storage areas.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure samples, wardrobe, and production materials are prepared and available ahead of shoots.
* Track deliverables, deadlines, and outstanding action items, providing timely updates and following through to completion.
* Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, logistical challenges, and production needs; escalate issues and propose solutions.
* Build and maintain relationships with creative talent, agencies, vendors, and production partners.
* Support inclusive casting and vendor sourcing practices across productions.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS  

* 1–3 years of experience in production coordination, photography production, fashion, e-commerce, or a related field preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to own assigned responsibilities, work independently, and consistently follow through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including proactive status updates and early identification of issues.
* Resourceful, adaptable, and solutions-oriented, with sound judgment and effective prioritization skills.
* Comfortable balancing administrative work with hands-on, physical support in a production environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and production planning tools.
* Experience coordinating freelance crews, vendors, budgets, and production schedules preferred.
* Experience supporting high-volume e-commerce photography production strongly preferred.
* Ability to work extended hours on shoot days, including occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends as production schedules require.
* Ability to lift, move, and transport production materials and equipment up to 50 pounds occasionally, with or without reasonable accommodation.

$55,000 - $67,000 base salary (This range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for this NYC-based position. The base salary will depend on numerous factors such as: experience and qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to other AO employees.)  
This job description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee may be required to perform, and the employee may be required to perform additional functions. Additionally, the job responsibilities may change at any time as necessitated by business demands.

Met Council is America’s largest Jewish charity dedicated to serving the needy. We fight poverty through comprehensive social services and by treating each client with compassion, integrity, and respect. Our programs are staffed by experts who help over 350,000 clients each year and advocate on behalf of all needy New Yorkers. Our services include 100% affordable housing at 21 locations, family violence services, Holocaust survivor assistance, geriatric social work, crisis intervention and the largest free kosher food distribution program in the world. Our network of 101 food pantries, affordable housing sites, and affiliated JCCs provide services directly in neighborhoods across New York City.

**Position Summary:**

Through the National School Lunch Program (NSLP), Met Council administers and distributes kosher commodity foods to schools that are members of the state Kosher Co-Op, ensuring member schools have reliable access to that product. As part of Met Council's broader Food Programs team, NSLP requires a dedicated administrator: someone to help manage and reconcile digital inventory as well as assist with warehouse logistics. The NSLP Operations Administrator will also assist in making sure procurement is aligned with our 3PL partner on distribution, while using Market by Met Council (Salesforce-based) and Excel to keep operations grounded in accurate, reliable data.

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Use our Salesforce-based ERP, Market by Met Council, to track inventory, manage reports, and flag discrepancies.

* Coordinate with the NSLP Operations Manager, Procurement Manager, and 3PL partner on order processing, delivery logistics, and inventory distribution.

* Troubleshoot operational, logistics, and systems issues as needed.

* Report weekly on operational metrics (fulfillment, inventory accuracy) to leadership.

* Perform office management tasks, such as scheduling vendors, repairs, and inspections, as well as ensuring team members have the supplies and information, they need to accomplish their duties.

**Competencies:**

* Comfort using online technologies and database systems daily, or willingness to learn

* Professional, approachable, and customer-service oriented

* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment

* Ability to work independently as well as in a team

* Solid verbal and written communication skills

* Comfort working in a warehouse office environment

* Project management skills, including follow-up across departments and job titles

* Ability to follow organizational policies, procedures, and compliance requirements

**Skill and Education:**

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant work experience accepted

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in warehouse operations, logistics, distribution, or a related operational environment

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including using spreadsheets for operational tracking, reporting, and data analysis

* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM, ERP, inventory management, or similar operational system a plus

**Special Requirements:**

* Occasional travel among Met Council office locations and network agencies is required around the five boroughs, typically using public transport.

* Comfort working in a shared warehouse office environment.

**Benefits:** Major meidcal, dental, vision and life insurance; pre-tax commuter benefits; FSA; 403(b) with employer contribution; plus generous vacation, sick leave and holidays.

jobs.title: Community Outreach & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Denn’s Room Psychiatry**

Denn’s Room Psychiatry is a growing psychiatric private practice serving adults in New York. We do psychiatric evaluations and medication management. We work alongside primary care providers, therapists and counseling practices, and community organizations such as homeless shelters and supportive housing programs. We want to be the psychiatric partner that healthcare professionals and community organizations across New York can count on.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a self-directed, relationship-driven marketer to introduce Denn’s Room Psychiatry to the people and organizations who need a reliable psychiatric partner. You’ll be the face of the practice in the community. You’ll build referral relationships with three groups:

1. **Primary care practices.** Physicians, NPs, and practice managers who need somewhere to send patients for psychiatric evaluation and medication management.

2. **Therapists and counseling practices.** Independent therapists, group practices, and counseling or mental health organizations whose clients need medication management.

3. **Shelters and residential programs.** Homeless shelters, supportive housing, and residential organizations that need psychiatric services for their clients.

**You own the strategy.** We won’t hand you a script or a route. You decide where to start, which neighborhoods and organizations to prioritize, and how to build the relationships. We want someone who treats this as their own territory.

**What You’ll Do**

**Field Day (about 8 hours per week)**

* Visit primary care offices, therapy and counseling practices, shelters, and supportive housing programs in person

* Introduce the practice, leave materials, and identify the right contact at each site (practice manager, referral coordinator, case manager, program director)

* Attend community, provider, and networking events when they’re useful

* Find organizations that could become direct service contracts, such as shelters and residential programs

**Admin and Follow-Up Block (about 4 hours per week)**

* **Documentation:** Log every visit, contact, and conversation in the practice’s outreach tracker (who you met, what they need, next step)

* **Follow-up calls and cold calls:** Call back the contacts you met in person, work new leads, and turn interest into referrals

* **Patient scheduling:** Schedule referred patients into the provider’s available appointment slots using the practice’s calendar, and confirm the details with the patient or the referring office

* **Weekly update:** Send a short summary of visits, follow-ups, new referral sources, and patients booked

**Ongoing**

* Keep referral partners happy with prompt responses and smooth handoffs

* Share field feedback with the practice owner: what partners need, common objections, and gaps in what we offer

* Represent the practice professionally and with compassion when talking with vulnerable populations

*As the practice grows, patient scheduling will move to a dedicated virtual assistant or practice manager, so you can focus fully on outreach.*

**Requirements**

* **Experience in marketing, outreach, sales, or business development** (healthcare or community-based preferred)

* Comfortable walking into offices unannounced, cold calling, and following up persistently

* Strong verbal and written communication

* Organized and self-directed. You can plan your own field day and keep accurate records without being micromanaged

* Comfortable with Google Workspace (Calendar, Sheets, Gmail) or similar tools

* Familiar with getting around NYC by public transit

* Discretion with confidential information. You’ll handle patient scheduling details and must complete HIPAA training before starting

* Authorized to work in the United States

**Preferred**

* **Background in case management, social work, community health work, or healthcare administration.** This helps you speak credibly with clinicians, case managers, and shelter staff

* Familiarity with the NYC shelter system, supportive housing, FQHCs, or community mental health organizations

* Basic understanding of insurance (commercial, Medicaid managed care, Medicare)

* Bilingual (Spanish or another language widely spoken in NYC)

* Existing relationships with NYC primary care, behavioral health, or social service organizations

**Compensation and Support**

* **Pay:** $24 to $28 per hour, based on experience

* **Additional incentives:** Performance-based incentives are available on top of the hourly rate

* **Transit:** The practice provides an OMNY card (or transit reimbursement) for work travel

* Flexible scheduling within the weekly hours

* Room to grow into a larger outreach or practice-growth role, including expansion into New Jersey

**How to Apply**

Send your resume and a few sentences about a relationship or referral source you built from scratch, and how you did it.

*Denn’s Room Psychiatry is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Expected hours: 12.0 per week

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**About the Company**
---------------------

Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation joined by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.

**About the Role:**  
The best Talent teams run on exceptional coordination & operations support.

We’re looking for a Recruiting & Talent Coordinator in NYC to help us deliver a fast, organized, and high-trust experience for candidates and hiring teams. You’ll keep interviews moving, maintain the integrity of our recruiting systems, support recruiters and hiring managers, and make sure every candidate interaction reflects the quality and ambition of Valon.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who loves details, moves with urgency, communicates clearly, and sees every process as an opportunity to improve.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Candidate and interview operations**

* Coordinate complex interview schedules across candidates, interviewers, recruiters, and hiring managers.
* Own candidate communication throughout the process, including confirmations, preparation, updates, and follow-up.
* Ensure candidates have a thoughtful, consistent, and timely experience from first conversation through offer and preboarding.
* Prepare interview plans, interviewer briefs, feedback reminders, and other materials that help the process run smoothly.
* Identify and resolve scheduling or process issues before they affect the candidate experience.

### **Hiring team partnership**

* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep searches organized and moving forward.
* Coordinate intake meetings, debriefs, onsite interviews, and offer-related logistics.
* Keep hiring teams informed about pipeline activity, upcoming interviews, outstanding feedback, and next steps.
* Support recruiting events, university programs, referrals, and other talent initiatives.

### **Recruiting systems and reporting**

* Maintain accurate, timely data in Ashby and related recruiting systems.
* Ensure candidate records, interview feedback, stage movement, and reporting fields are complete and reliable.
* Build lightweight reporting and dashboards that help the team understand funnel health, speed, and candidate experience.
* Protect candidate confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

### **Process improvement**

* Create and maintain recruiting playbooks, templates, and operating procedures.
* Look for repetitive or error-prone workflows and improve them through automation, integrations, and AI-enabled tools.
* Help the recruiting team build processes that are repeatable, measurable, and scalable.
* Support sourcing, outreach, and talent research as needed.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 0-5 years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, people operations, executive assistance, or a related role.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and time zones without losing momentum.
* A high level of ownership, follow-through, and sound judgment.
* Comfort working in an evolving environment where processes are still being built.
* Experience with an ATS or recruiting tools such as Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, or similar systems.
* A genuine interest in improving workflows through automation and AI.
* Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential candidate and employee information.

*Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.*

*Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager- New York City/Bronx, NY
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  
MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  
MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high-energy, self-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  
**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory

**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  

* 1-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well-developed multi-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide

**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  

* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle

**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  

* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers

**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.

Visit us at https://www.mdlab.com/
  
  
Medical Diagnostic Laboratories is a member of Genesis Global Group, an equal opportunity employer.

Water Engineering Services, Inc. (WES) is seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly organized **Water Treatment Account Manager** to join our growing team!

We are a privately owned water treatment and Legionella compliance company serving New Jersey, New York City, Delaware, and surrounding areas. We specialize in commercial and industrial water treatment, cooling tower maintenance, Legionella prevention, and regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a motivated, mechanically inclined professional with **hands-on experience servicing cooling towers and water treatment systems** who can confidently manage multiple customer accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who takes ownership of their responsibilities, manages their time effectively, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service.

Key Responsibilities

* Independently manage and service multiple customer accounts throughout an assigned territory.
* Organize and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly service schedules, ensuring all visits and responsibilities are completed on time.
* Perform routine water treatment services for cooling towers, boilers, closed-loop systems, and other commercial water systems.
* Conduct chemical testing, water analysis, and necessary treatment adjustments.
* Inspect, troubleshoot, calibrate, and maintain chemical feed pumps, controllers, piping, and related equipment.
* Monitor cooling tower conditions and identify potential maintenance, mechanical, or water treatment issues.
* Assist with Legionella sampling, disinfection procedures, and compliance-related services.
* Maintain strong relationships with customers through regular communication and timely follow-up.
* Complete accurate and detailed service reports during each customer visit.
* Identify additional customer needs, recommend solutions, and communicate service opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal team members to ensure service schedules, customer needs, and compliance requirements are met.
* Assist with occasional cooling tower cleanings, equipment installations, and special projects.
* Follow all company safety procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

**Required:**

* Previous hands-on experience servicing cooling towers and commercial or industrial water treatment systems.
* Strong understanding of water treatment practices, chemical testing, and treatment adjustments.
* Mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and service water treatment equipment.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple customer accounts and service schedules.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to complete accurate reports and maintain detailed service records.
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
* Comfortable working in mechanical rooms, on rooftops, and in varying weather conditions.

**Preferred but Not Required:**

* Plumbing, pipefitting, or HVAC experience.
* Experience installing and repairing chemical feed pumps, controllers, and piping.
* Knowledge of Legionella prevention and cooling tower compliance requirements.
* Experience with boilers, closed-loop systems, and domestic water treatment.
* Familiarity with NYC Department of Health cooling tower regulations.

What We're Looking For

Beyond technical experience, we are looking for someone who is:

* **Reliable and accountable:** Takes responsibility for assigned accounts, follows through, and consistently completes work.
* **Organized and efficient:** Manages time effectively, prioritizes tasks, and keeps service schedules on track.
* **Independent and self-motivated:** Comfortable working in the field without constant supervision.
* **Detail-oriented:** Understands the importance of accurate testing, proper documentation, and consistent service.
* **Proactive:** Identifies problems early, communicates concerns, and takes initiative.
* **Professional and personable:** Builds positive customer relationships and represents our company well.
* **Adaptable:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change.

Why Join WES?

Water Engineering Services is an established and growing company in an essential industry. We take pride in providing exceptional service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and delivering high-quality water treatment and Legionella compliance programs.

We value employees who are dependable, hardworking, and committed to doing their jobs well.

If you have experience in cooling tower and water treatment service, enjoy working independently, and are looking for an opportunity to grow with an established company, we'd love to hear from you!

**Apply today to join the Water Engineering Services team!**

jobs.description:
**Octus**

Octus is a leading global provider of credit intelligence, data, and analytics. Since 2013, tens of thousands of professionals across hedge fund, investment banking, management consulting, and law firm verticals have come to rely on Octus to make better, faster, and more confident decisions in pace with the fast-moving credit markets.
  
For more information, visit: https://octus.com/

**Working at Octus**

Octus hires growth-minded innovators and trailblazers across the globe to drive our business and culture. Our core values – Action Oriented, Customer First Mindset, Effective Team Players, and Driven to Excel – define an organizational ethos that's as high-performing as it is human. Among other perks, Octus employees enjoy competitive health benefits, matched 401k and pension plans, PTO, generous parental leave, gym subsidies, educational reimbursements for career development, recognition programs, and much more.  
  
**Role**

The Customer Success Specialist will be responsible for managing a book of existing **law firm** clients while supporting our efforts to promote processes, drive retention rates, increase usage and develop stakeholder relationships. The Customer Success Specialist will possess strong communication, relationship building, and problem solving skills.

**Responsibilities**

* Become an Octus expert with an understanding of the Legal segment and our law firm clients, our products, services, and the financial restructuring industry/process, along with the sub-investment grade market
* Manage a book of law firm accounts to understand their business drivers and goals and ensure they are sticky with the Octus product suite
* Develop key relationships and drive usage with a wide range of subscribers through understanding each of their different workflows, educating them on best practices on how to use their subscription, gathering feedback, and providing updates on new functionalities/databases
* Leverage existing customer relationships and expand the network of relevant contacts within each client to become the partner of choice for their needs
* Monitor key performance indicators across accounts and strategize outreach efforts through emails, phone calls, and in-person meetings to maximize usage and adoption
* Act as the voice of the customer when collaborating with various internal teams across sales, editorial, product, and tech to ensure our client's needs are met
* Work closely with the sales team to develop account strategy, monitor client's platform usage, and share findings from client interactions, including but not limited to relaying new firm knowledge and potential expansion opportunities to ensure customer growth

**Requirements**

* 0-2 years of working experience in a customer facing role; this could include relevant internships (note: we are very open to promising recent graduates)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* A self-starter who is diligent and organized, but adaptable and creative

The actual compensation will be at Octus' sole discretion and will be determined by the aforementioned and other relevant factors.

Octus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. jobs.title: Inside Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
Fortell is harnessing AI and custom silicon to build the world’s best hearing aids. Our mission is to empower people to hear better everywhere — even in the most challenging environments — so they can connect, thrive, and enjoy life to the fullest. We’re driven by cutting-edge technology, user-centric design, and a passion for improving lives. We are a NY-based startup backed by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Valor Equity Partners, Lux Capital and Optum Ventures, among others.

**About the role.**

Success in hearing care starts with the first conversation. Fortell is looking to hire a highly motivated, detail-oriented Inside Sales Specialist to manage and convert inbound demand while delivering an exceptional first impression of our brand.

This role is responsible for handling inbound calls, responding to leads that sign up through our website intake, and making timely outbound follow-ups to qualify interest and schedule appointments in our clinics. You will be the primary owner of lead management in Salesforce, ensuring impeccable documentation, accurate handoffs, and a seamless experience from first contact through clinic arrival.

This is a full-time role that works closely with Sales, Audiology, Operations, and Product teams. You will play a critical role in driving clinic utilization, conversion, and long-term customer success by setting the right expectations early and ensuring every lead is handled with care, urgency, and professionalism.

**Responsibilities.**

* Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients, handling inbound calls, web leads, and inquiries with a warm, empathetic, and professional approach.
* Make timely outbound calls to leads who complete website intake forms to assess needs, answer early questions, and schedule clinic appointments.
* Conduct intake and qualification conversations to understand hearing challenges, readiness, and fit for Fortell’s products and services.
* Drive a high scheduling rate of qualified leads by clearly communicating value, next steps, and what to expect from an in-clinic visit.
* Own end-to-end lead management in Salesforce, including:
* Accurate data entry and lead status management
* Clear, detailed call notes and dispositioning
* Proper routing and handoff to clinics and care teams
* Maintain impeccably clean documentation that enables seamless coordination across Sales, Audiology, and Operations.
* Manage follow-ups and rescheduling to minimize no-shows and maximize clinic efficiency.
* Handle objections and questions with confidence and empathy, helping prospective clients feel informed and supported.
* Meet or exceed key performance metrics tied to responsiveness, scheduling rate, documentation quality, and lead conversion.
* Partner closely with clinic and audiology teams to ensure scheduled patients arrive prepared and well-informed.
* Identify patterns, gaps, or opportunities in lead flow and share insights with leadership to improve intake processes and conversion.
* Uphold privacy, compliance, and data accuracy standards at all times.

**What you’ll bring.**

* 2+ years of experience in inside sales, inbound/outbound calling, lead qualification, or customer-facing sales roles — ideally in healthcare, audiology, or a service-based environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build trust quickly over the phone.
* Strong sales instincts balanced with empathy and a consultative, patient-first approach.
* Meticulous attention to detail and a high standard for CRM hygiene and documentation.
* Proven experience managing leads and workflows in Salesforce (or similar CRM); Salesforce proficiency strongly preferred.
* Ability to handle high call volumes while maintaining quality conversations and accurate records.
* Comfort navigating sensitive conversations with an older demographic and setting clear expectations.
* Highly organized, self-directed, and accountable — you take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.
* A proactive mindset: you anticipate needs, follow through reliably, and look for ways to improve the intake experience.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Hawksmoor is a British steakhouse group, currently ranked No. 2 in the world among multi-site steakhouse groups by the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants awards. We have three restaurants in the US: New York, Boston and Chicago, and this role owns the organic social media strategy across all of them, working alongside our Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead.

Our growth in the US rests on the same obsession that built the brand in the UK: real sourcing, real cooking, and a genuine point of view, carried through everything from the menu to the media we put out. This role is responsible for turning that into a considered, confident organic social strategy that builds Hawksmoor's reputation across three major US markets, and then for executing it hands-on, building the strategy and creating the content that brings it to life, in close partnership with our UK-based brand marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

*Strategy & Planning*

* Collaborate with the Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead to develop and present the U.S. organic social media strategy in line with Hawksmoor’s business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Create and maintain monthly and quarterly social media plans for U.S. restaurants, aligned with wider business activity and culturally relevant moments.
* Act as the primary lead for Hawksmoor’s social media presence in the U.S., while working closely with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency of tone and brand messaging across regions.
* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content & Scheduling*

* Manage day-to-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community & Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co-creation, user-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights & Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.

Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food & beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer-facing brand.
* Hands-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end-to-end with a track record of managing high-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality-first instinct rather than a trend-chasing one. Our guest is 35+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
#### **About Us**

**ISMG** is a global media and intelligence firm covering cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. Through 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and more than 400 events each year, we reach over 2 million executives, decision-makers, and innovators. We help technology and cybersecurity companies connect with that audience through media campaigns, executive events, and demand generation programs.

#### **About the Opportunity**

As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR)**, you’ll help build ISMG’s new business pipeline by starting conversations with marketing leaders at technology and cybersecurity companies. You’ll learn who they’re trying to reach, what they want to achieve, and where an ISMG campaign or event could support their goals. When you identify a fit, you’ll arrange a discovery meeting with one of our Business Development Managers (BDMs) or Account Executives.

You’ll build your B2B sales skills through hands-on prospecting, daily coaching, and mentorship from experienced sellers. After successfully completing the development program, you may be considered for a BDM role with broader sales responsibilities and greater earning potential.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* **Research and prioritize accounts.** Identify prospective clients and the people who shape their marketing decisions. Use company news, buying signals, and prospecting tools to find a timely reason to reach out.
* **Start conversations.** Make cold calls, write personalized emails, and use social outreach to engage prospects. Tailor your message to the person’s role, audience, and marketing priorities.
* **Qualify opportunities and book discovery meetings.** Ask questions about the prospect’s goals and upcoming initiatives, assess where ISMG can help, and agree on a next step with the right member of our sales team.
* **Prepare the sales team for each meeting.** Share who will attend, what the prospect wants to accomplish, and why they agreed to meet so your colleague can pick up where you left off.
* **Manage performance against KPIs.** Work toward agreed activity and quality targets, tracking how often outreach leads to conversations and how many qualified meetings the sales team accepts and prospects attend. Review results with your manager and use coaching to improve your approach.
* **Maintain CRM records.** Keep outreach, qualification notes, meeting outcomes, and next steps current.

#### **What You Bring**

* An interest in building a B2B sales career and learning how technology companies reach cybersecurity and IT decision-makers.
* Clear writing and the willingness to pick up the phone and start a conversation with someone new.
* Curiosity and strong listening skills. You ask follow-up questions and use what you learn to shape the conversation.
* Persistence when prospects don’t respond, along with the organization to manage multiple accounts and follow through on commitments.
* A willingness to practice, act on feedback, and learn CRM and prospecting tools.

Previous sales, internship, or customer-facing experience is helpful. We also welcome applicants pursuing their first sales role. Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar tools is a plus.

#### **What We Offer**

* A base salary, uncapped commission on initial sales from opportunities you generate, and the opportunity to earn quarterly bonuses for meeting qualified meeting targets.
* Structured onboarding, daily coaching from sales leadership, and mentorship from experienced sales representatives.
* Hands-on experience selling media, events, and demand generation programs to marketing decision-makers.

If you’re ready to build a career in B2B sales, we’d like to hear from you. **Apply today.**

**100% Commission-Based | NY, NJ, Tri-State Area & Surrounding Markets | Flexible Schedule**

About SafeZone24

SafeZone24 is an established commercial security systems integrator with over 25 years of industry experience. We specialize in professional video surveillance (CCTV), access control, intrusion alarms, intercom systems, remote monitoring, and integrated security solutions.

We serve commercial properties, real estate developers, property management companies, construction firms, schools, houses of worship, community organizations, and other institutions throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated B2B Sales Representative or Business Development Professional who knows how to identify opportunities, build relationships, and bring in new projects.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with existing connections in commercial real estate, construction, property management, facilities management, or the security industry.

You focus on bringing in business. SafeZone24 provides the technical expertise, system design, project estimating, installation, and ongoing support.

Independent Contractor Opportunity

This opportunity is intended for an independent sales professional who operates their own business, controls their schedule and prospecting methods, and may represent other companies.

No daily office attendance is required. The representative independently develops business opportunities and coordinates with SafeZone24 when qualified projects are identified.

The relationship is intended to be governed by a written independent sales agreement, subject to applicable law.

Responsibilities

* Independently identify and pursue new commercial and institutional clients.
* Build relationships with property owners, developers, contractors, facility managers, and decision-makers.
* Generate qualified project opportunities through networking, outreach, and existing professional connections.
* Arrange client meetings and coordinate with our technical team.
* Follow up on proposals and help convert opportunities into signed projects.
* Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat business.
* Pursue business opportunities throughout New York, New Jersey, the Tri-State region, and surrounding markets.

Compensation

**This is a 100% commission-based opportunity with no guaranteed base salary.**

* Earn competitive commissions on qualifying new business you personally generate.
* Commissions are calculated based on eligible customer payments actually collected by SafeZone24.
* For projects paid in installments, commissions are calculated proportionally as eligible payments are received.
* No commission is paid merely for introductions, meetings, or proposals.
* Commission percentages, eligibility, earning and payment terms, and any adjustments will be defined in a written agreement compliant with applicable law.
* There is no guaranteed annual income. Earnings depend on successful business generation and customer collections.

Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, business development, or commercial account acquisition.
* Ability to independently prospect, develop relationships, and generate qualified opportunities.
* Experience in security systems, low-voltage technology, construction, commercial real estate, or related industries strongly preferred.
* Existing relationships with commercial property owners, developers, contractors, or facility managers are a significant advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to attend client meetings and site visits throughout the Tri-State region and surrounding markets.

Why Partner With SafeZone24?

* Established company with 25+ years of industry experience.
* Broad portfolio of commercial and institutional security solutions.
* Professional technical team handling design, estimating, installation, and service.
* Opportunity to generate business across multiple markets and industries.
* Freedom to independently manage your schedule and business-development activities.
* Performance-based earning potential tied to successful projects.

**If you have the industry connections, sales experience, and drive to bring in commercial projects, we'd like to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Are you interested in a 100% commission-based B2B sales opportunity with no guaranteed base salary, where commissions are paid on qualifying business after SafeZone24 receives payment from the customer?
* Have you independently generated and closed B2B sales opportunities? If yes, briefly describe the industries you worked in, how you found customers, and the types or approximate values of projects you closed.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Corporate Business Development (CorpBD) team at Amazon is looking for an Executive Assistant to support three Directors. CorpBD works with business leaders across Amazon to identify, negotiate, and manage partnerships that improve customer experience and support the company's long-term strategic vision.
  
  
As an Executive Assistant on this global team, you will manage complex calendars, coordinate domestic and international travel, plan events, and serve as a trusted point of contact between your leaders and stakeholders across the organization. You will bring strong organizational skills and sound judgment to a fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact leadership effectiveness and team morale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Manage complex calendars and scheduling for three Directors, balancing competing priorities with professionalism and discretion.
* Plan and execute events of varying scale, including team off-sites, staff meetings, and organizational gatherings, while coordinating logistics with stakeholders.
* Coordinate cost-effective domestic and international travel arrangements, creating detailed itineraries that account for time zone transitions and ground transportation.
* Prepare and curate content on behalf of leaders in partnership with key stakeholders, including meeting agendas, correspondence, and presentations, while handling confidential information with care.
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and leverage productivity tools — including generative AI where appropriate — to increase efficiency and quality of support.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning starts with a review of emails and calendar updates, adjusting schedules across time zones and confirming the day's priorities with your Directors. From there, you might finalize travel plans for an upcoming trip, pull together an agenda for a cross-team meeting, or troubleshoot a last-minute scheduling conflict. You serve as a reliable point of communication throughout the day, connecting your leaders with the right people and information when it matters.  
  
About the team  
CorpBD is a centralized function within Amazon's Corporate Business Development organization, working horizontally across the company's businesses. The team focuses on evaluating and structuring non-standard or first-of-their-kind deals, centralizing strategic partnerships, and providing strategic advisory support to internal teams. With roughly 70 employees globally, you will collaborate with colleagues across geographies and partner closely with other executive assistants, recruiting, facilities, and human resources teams. Amazon's administrative community is active and supportive, with opportunities for skill development, peer learning, and finding new ways to streamline work so you can make a bigger impact on team priorities.

* 2+ years of professional or military experience

* Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
